elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if that person causes the death of another person by driving a mechanically propelled vehicle dangerously on a road or other public place.
elements.quote: A person who causes the death of another person by driving a mechanically propelled vehicle dangerously on a road or other public place is guilty of an offence.
